beats.headline: Nobody else touches your chair.
beats.body: We uncrate it, test it, drive it to your door, build it in your room, and come back when you call. One team from the crate to the handover, and the same team on the phone a year later.

beats.headline: Hundreds of dental chairs
beats.body: In clinics across the Philippines. Every one of them uncrated, tested and signed off in our warehouse before it left, then assembled in the operatory by our own technicians.

beats.headline: The people I'd build anything with.
beats.body: Most of them worked inside real clinics before they ever stood on a sales floor. They learn at our Training Center in Pasig, and then they teach in the same room, which is why the person who answers your question has usually done the thing you are asking about.

beats.headline: The largest dental showroom in the country
beats.body: 610 C. Raymundo Avenue, Maybunga, Pasig City. Open Monday to Sunday, 9 AM to 8 PM. Compare models side by side in the same light, sit in them, and bring your operatory measurements.

beats.headline: Exclusive Philippine distributor for ROSON
beats.body: ROSON marked twenty years at Dental South China in March 2026. Its chairs reach Filipino clinics through one channel, straight from the source, so the unit on our floor is the unit ROSON shipped.

beats.headline: Exclusive Denjoy partner in the Philippines
beats.body: Announced on May 30, 2026, and on the showroom floor from June 4. Endo motors, apex locators, ultrasonic activators and the workstations that hold them, with the spares and the support kept here.

beats.headline: A room of phantom heads, minutes away
beats.body: Units 307 and 308, 3rd Floor, Mercedes Square Plaza, Mercedes Avenue corner Luis Street, San Miguel, Pasig City. A row of simulator stations, an interactive teaching board, and courses run with partner study groups.

beats.headline: We deliver, and we install what we deliver
beats.body: Clinics on Luzon are served by our own van and installation team. Units bound for the Visayas and Mindanao go by freight, with installation arranged on arrival. A free ocular visit comes first, so the unit fits the room.

beats.headline: Opened here, not in your operatory
beats.body: Every unit is uncrated, assembled, powered up and tested in our warehouse first. Eight checks, one technician signing the sheet, and nothing released for delivery until that sheet is complete.

beats.headline: The chair is the room, so downtime is the cost
beats.body: Our technicians assess a fault on site first, and we hold parts locally for that reason. When the assessment says it will not clear quickly, we deliver a replacement unit and take the affected one back.

beats.headline: More than ninety articles, from our own posts
beats.body: Installs, showroom days, conventions, training sessions and product arrivals. Each one written from the Facebook post it came from, dated to the day it happened, with the original post linked at the end.

beats.headline: The ten questions we are asked most
beats.body: Price, installment, delivery outside Metro Manila, after sales, showroom hours, training, spare parts and installation time. The answers are here, and the inquiry form sits at the end of them.

beats.headline: Press and hold any of them
beats.body: Thirty three reels from conventions, installs, training days and ordinary afternoons on the floor. No stock footage and no actors. Press and hold a marble to watch the one you are curious about.

beats.headline: The real DentaSource.
beats.body: True enthusiasts and professionals in their craft. The crew I get to build with every day, and they bring it. Real footage, no stock photos.

beats.headline: Come and sit in the chair
beats.body: 610 C. Raymundo Avenue, Maybunga, Pasig City, Monday to Sunday, 9 AM to 8 PM. No appointment needed, though telling us you are coming means the model you want is set up and powered when you arrive.
